About the company

War Horse Roofing

Wade LeBeau founded War Horse Roofing in Fremont County after decades in construction and roofing. Today the veteran-owned company restores commercial roofs across Wyoming.

One of Wade’s goals as a business owner is to help other veterans start companies of their own.
